text:
erin_marketing: quick sync — targeting Tue 10:00 PT for the public announce. marketing needs final changelog URL, doc landing page, a 1-line benchmark for socials, and the canonical demo snippet by EOD tomorrow. can eng/product commit? :calendar:

devin_eng: changelog PR is in review, should merge tomorrow morning. docs landing page is ready but slug may change, pinging @anu_product for final slug.

anu_product: will finalize slug and add a short 'what this means' bullet today. webinar: want Wed 11am PT for the live Q&A. good?

erin_marketing: Wed 11am PT works — marketing will do a 24h follow-up email and route inbound leads to the SDR playbook. can we add a short sentence in changelog about inbound routing and demo access?

slo_release: release plan: canary prechecks 09:50 PT, announce embargo lift at 10:05 PT, full ramp by 13:00 PT. prefer embargo lift only after canary metric pass. deploy-bot will run prechecks at 09:45 PT.

deploy-bot: scheduled precheck job: start=2026-09-02T09:45:00Z, target=canary-pool-7, alert=#eng-oncall.

devin_eng: benchmark shortline (draft): "~18% median latency improvement at 512 tokens; unit cost down ~25% with default batching + KV cache." short enough for social?

tess_marketing: that fits the headline. marketing also needs a 280-char version with CTA to docs + webinar link placeholder. i'll draft after we lock the slug.

erin_marketing: also need a canonical demo code snippet for the docs and tweet thread. prefer a tidy curl example plus a minimal JS fetch. can eng drop both in the changelog?

devin_eng: will add curl and node fetch examples to changelog. sample curl we'll use: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rw1-large","input":"Summarize the following"}'
```

anu_product: inbound lead routing note: please add that marketing leads go to SDR queue "launch-inbound" with tag "2026-09-infer" and priority=high for 48h. i'll include this in the docs and in the webinar slide.

erin_marketing: perfect. marketing also wants a single-sentence "what to say" for support and SDRs to avoid confusion if customers ask about compatibility/migration. can product draft that here?

anu_product: draft support line: "No API changes required for most users; update to latest client for optimized batching and cache benefits — see migration notes in docs."

devin_eng: quick note: one perf number may shift after final perf pass. will post any changes with "update:" prefix to this thread.

erin_marketing: pls do that — we'll freeze social text 2 hours before announce. also need confirmation that the docs URL will be public at announce time (no auth gates).

devin_eng: docs will be public. changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/529 (will update slug once product confirms). docs draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/2026-09-inference-update

slo_release: rollback criteria for the webinar slide: 1) sustained error rate > 1% for 5 minutes, 2) P95 latency > 2x baseline for 10 minutes. will add wording to the rollout doc and share link.

erin_marketing: timeline recap: EOD tomorrow = changelog merged + docs slug final + demo snippets + single-sentence support line. 09:45 PT prechecks, 09:50 PT canary start, embargo lift 10:05 PT, full ramp by 13:00 PT, webinar Wed 11am PT. if everyone confirms here i'll lock the calendar and schedule posts. :white_check_mark:

devin_eng: confirmed. merging PR tomorrow morning and will flag updates here.

anu_product: confirmed — dropping final slug and support one-liner into this thread when done.

tess_marketing: confirmed — i'll draft the social + newsletter and post for an engineering accuracy pass before scheduling.

devin_eng: update: final perf pass changed median improvement to 16% (was ~18%). updating PR and changelog now.

erin_marketing: got it — we'll use 16% in the teaser. thanks all, please prefix any metric changes with "update:" as requested. :rocket:
